drivers.name: Federal Reserve monetary policy
drivers.why: Fed policy affects discount rates, dollar funding and global capital flows; the direction depends on the actual release, not the headline alone.

drivers.why: RBI policy affects Indian borrowing costs, liquidity and rate-sensitive companies. Banks can respond differently from borrowers.

drivers.name: US 10-year nominal yield
drivers.why: Higher US nominal yields can pressure equity valuations and emerging-market flows. This series does not measure real yields or the reason yields moved.
drivers.observation: 2026-11-06: 4.859 %; +0.46% over one session and -1.42% over five.

drivers.name: US Dollar Index
drivers.why: A stronger dollar can tighten global financial conditions and pressure foreign capital flows; exporters may respond differently.
drivers.observation: 2026-11-06: 102.3 index; +0.74% over one session and +0.41% over five.

drivers.name: USD / INR
drivers.why: A higher USD/INR raises rupee costs for dollar importers while potentially helping exporters; hedges and foreign-currency debt matter.
drivers.observation: 2026-11-06: 94.4589 INR per USD; -0.06% over one session and -0.73% over five.

drivers.name: Brent front-month futures
drivers.why: Higher Brent can raise India's import bill and input costs. Producers, refiners and consumer businesses have different exposures.
drivers.observation: 2026-11-06: 98.32 USD per barrel; +0.03% over one session and -16.42% over five.

drivers.name: US VIX
drivers.why: Higher US implied volatility signals greater demand for protection. It is a risk-sentiment indicator, not an Indian price forecast.
drivers.observation: 2026-11-06: 25.64 index; -9.01% over one session and +32.03% over five.

drivers.name: Gold front-month futures
drivers.why: Gold can reflect shifts in real-rate expectations, the dollar or defensive demand. Price alone cannot identify the cause.
drivers.observation: 2026-11-06: 4074.9 USD per oz; -0.94% over one session and +4.51% over five.

drivers.name: NSE provisional FII / DII cash activity

limitations: Jev classifies the supplied evidence; it does not independently browse, generate research prose or verify a news claim.
Macro labels are conditional model judgments. Model confidence is not a probability of trading profit.
Completed daily prices and periodic feeds only; no live intraday levels, order book or institutional price levels.

Real yields, market-implied rate probabilities, consensus economic forecasts, comprehensive geopolitical news, ETF/COT positioning and earnings/sales fundamentals are not supplied. What is priced in is unknown.
The US calendar covers BLS releases only. RBI headlines and NSE board meetings are not a complete Indian economic calendar. Unavailable feeds are never treated as an absence of risk.
Source titles and short metadata are supplied to Jev; linked full filings must be read before interpreting company fundamentals.
Context does not override entry gates, stops or position sizing. Existing HH/HL and VCP strategy rules remain the comparison baseline.

forward_test.method: Prospective descriptive comparison: first session open strictly after publication to the 5th/10th session close, less 0.40 percentage points round-trip costs. Equal weight within date, then equal weight across dates. Missing bars excluded. After-close snapshots only; model and rule version frozen.
forward_test.limitation: These are forward stock returns, not strategy P&L: no breakout fills, stops, sizing or portfolio simulation. Dates and stocks overlap. VCP watch rows are not executed trades. No improvement or causal edge established.
